name: b2_unary_first
literal_header:
private lemma b2_unary_first (M : FinTM Bool) (f : ℕ → List Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hM : ∀ n, M.ComputesInTime (List.replicate n true) (f n) (T n)) :
    ∃ τ : ℕ → ℕ, ∀ x : List Bool,
      τ x.length ≤ T x.length ∧
      (b2UnaryTM M).ComputesInTime x (f x.length) (τ x.length) ∧
      ∀ s < τ x.length, ((b2UnaryTM M).tm.runFrom
        ((b2UnaryTM M).tm.initCfg x) s).state ≠ none
route: Apply the canonical theorem to M.tm at each unary input and deadline T n; choose the resulting witnesses as the function τ. Retain b2_unary_run and output packaging. Full endpoint equality supplies state/output at τ; prefix exclusion transfers through the existing unary relation.

name: b2_verify_timed
literal_header:
private lemma b2_verify_timed (S V : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (y : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T : ℕ) (hV : V.ComputesInTime y [b] T)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (heads : Fin S.k → ℤ) (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = T + 1) :
    let out := (b2Host S V).tm.runWith w
      (b2VerifyCfg S V (V.tm.initCfg y) true p tapes heads)
    out.state = none ∧ out.output = [b]
route: Apply to V.tm, V.tm.initCfg y, and deadline T from hV. Retain choice-word splitting, b2_verify_run/finish, and output_unique packaging; use canonical prefix exclusion and endpoint state at the selected t.

name: call_run
literal_header:
theorem call_run (P : RProg m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (hl : c0.state = some l) (hcall : P.call l = some cs)
    (hW : ∀ r ∈ cs.args, c0.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape (W r))
    (hW0 : ∀ r ∈ cs.args, c0.workTapePos r = 0) (hnd : cs.args.Nodup)
    (hin : c0.inputPos.val = 1) (b : Bool) (B : ℕ)
    (hD : CleanRun D (q0 cs.dec) (vword (callSegs cs x W)) b B) :
    ∃ T, (∀ t ≤ T, RegBox cs c0.workTapePos W (fun r => ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
          (seam c0) t).workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r)) ∧
        ∀ i, |((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c0) t).workTapePos (Fin.natAdd m i)| ≤ B) ∧
      (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c0) T =
        seam { c0 with state := some (if b then cs.yes else cs.no), inputPos := 1 }
route: Apply to D and dc0 at deadline T using hTh. Keep the existing proof that dc0 starts live to establish T0>0, and retain all simulation, head/framing, and output packaging.

name: cleanTM_run
literal_header:
theorem cleanTM_run (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (q₁ q : S) (V : List Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hT : (M.runFrom (Cfg.init q V) T).state = none) (s : ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ i, (M.visitedByTapeHead (Cfg.init q V) T i).card ≤ s) :
    ∃ T', ((cleanTM M q₁).runFrom (Cfg.init (.init q) V) T').state = none ∧
      ((cleanTM M q₁).runFrom (Cfg.init (.init q) V) T').output =
        (M.runFrom (Cfg.init q V) T).output ∧
      ((cleanTM M q₁).runFrom (Cfg.init (.init q) V) T').workTapes = (fun _ _ => none) ∧
      ((cleanTM M q₁).runFrom (Cfg.init (.init q) V) T').workTapePos = (fun _ => 0) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ T', ∀ j, |((cleanTM M q₁).runFrom (Cfg.init (.init q) V) t).workTapePos j| ≤ s
route: Apply to M at Cfg.init q V and deadline T using hT. The theorem accepts an arbitrary configuration, so the local retagged M' is irrelevant to the selector; retain it where later visited-head bounds use it. Keep the cleaning/framing proof.

name: runFrom_count_eq
literal_header:
theorem runFrom_count_eq [Fintype St] (tm : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool St) (B P T : ℕ)
    (hwrite : ∀ q a w, ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = none ∨
      ((tm.tr q a w).workTapes (Fin.last K)).1 = some (some true))
    (hT : (tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) T).state = none)
    (hbox : ∀ t ≤ T, (∀ i : Fin K, |(tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos i.castSucc| ≤ B) ∧
      |(tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos (Fin.last K)| ≤ P) :
    tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) ((Fintype.card St + 1) * (x.length + 2) * 3 ^ (K * (2 * B + 1)) *
      (2 * B + 1) ^ K * ((2 * P + 1) * (2 * P + 2))) = tm.runFrom (tm.initCfg x) T
route: Apply to tm at tm.initCfg x and deadline T. Re-express the result using local run notation. Keep the cell/counting bound and stationary tail proof; no generalized API is needed for the selector.

name: clockTM_setup
literal_header:
lemma clockTM_setup (x s : List Bool) (tK : ℕ) (hK : K.ComputesInTime x s tK) :
    ∃ (a : ℕ) (kt : Fin K.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (kh : Fin K.k → ℤ),
      a ≤ tK + s.length + x.length + 5 ∧
      (clockTM K W).tm.runFrom ((clockTM K W).tm.initCfg x) a =
        ctrCfg K W (some (.dec W.tm.q₀ .empty)) (W.tm.initCfg x) (bufferTape s) 0 kt kh []
route: Apply to K.tm at K.tm.initCfg x and deadline tK from hK. Keep buffer/rewind setup and output_unique. Mechanical edit authority for colleague-owned ClockMachine remains a separate ownership check, not an API issue.

name: startup
literal_header:
theorem startup {T : ℕ} (hS : S.ComputesInTime x (List.replicate m true) T)
    (hm : x.length ≤ m) :
    ∃ s₀ ≤ T + m + 2, ∃ (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ),
      ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = s₀ →
        (hostTM S A loop).runWith w ((hostTM S A loop).initCfg x) =
          runCfg m (A.tm.initCfg x) 0 sT sP
route: Apply to the deterministic boot machine S.tm at deadline T from hS. Retain the NDTM host choice-word boot/rewind packaging; the minimized run itself is deterministic, so this belongs in the deterministic selector list.

name: clockStageCfg_captures
literal_header:
lemma clockStageCfg_captures (W : FinTM Bool) (a b : ℕ) (T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hW : ∀ x, W.ComputesInTime x (T x.length).bits (b * (T x.length + 1))) (x : List Bool) :
    ∃ τ ≤ b * (T x.length + 1), ∃ c : Cfg W.k Bool W.State x,
      c.state = none ∧ c.output = (T x.length).bits ∧
      (obliviousSchedule W a).tm.runFrom
        ((obliviousSchedule W a).tm.initCfg (x.map oblEmbed)) (τ + 1) = clockStageCfg W a c
route: Apply to (maskedClock W false).tm at deadline b*(T x.length+1), using existing hm/hhalt. Retain clockStageCfg_run and output_unique. The complete endpoint equality supplies halted state/output at τ.

name: one_work_tape
literal_header:
theorem one_work_tape {Γ : Type} [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    (M : FinTM Γ) (f : List Γ → List Γ) (T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) :
    ∃ (Γ' : Type) (_ : Fintype Γ') (_ : DecidableEq Γ') (e : Γ ↪ Γ')
      (M' : FinTM Γ') (c : ℕ),
      M'.k = 1 ∧ M'.ComputesFunInTimeVia e f fun n => c * (T n + 1) ^ 2
route: Apply in the positive-k branch to M.tm at deadline T x.length. Keep the sweep simulation and quadratic-time arithmetic; canonical equality transfers output at τ.

name: dg_all_inputs
literal_header:
private lemma dg_all_inputs {Γ : Type} [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    (M : FinTM Γ) (hk : 0 < M.k) (a₀ : Γ)
    (f : List Γ → List Γ) (T S : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T)
    (hS : ∀ y t, M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg y) t ≤ S y.length)
    (x : List (SweepAlphabet Γ M.k)) :
    (dgTM M a₀).ComputesInTime x ((f (x.map (dgRetract a₀))).map (sweepEmbed Γ M.k))
      ((9 * M.k + 6) * (T x.length + 1) ^ 2) ∧
    ∀ t, (dgTM M a₀).tm.spaceUsed ((dgTM M a₀).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      (9 * M.k + 6) * (S x.length + 1)
route: Apply to M.tm at input y=x.map(dgRetract a0), deadline T y.length. Keep dg_simulate, window/span, and space proof; use canonical prefix exclusion and endpoint equality for the local cut.

name: timedCapture_start
literal_header:
private lemma timedCapture_start (M : FinTM Bool) (clock : Fin M.k) (x : List Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (h : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T).state = none) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ T + 1 ∧
      (timedCaptureTM M clock).tm.runFrom ((timedCaptureTM M clock).tm.initCfg x) t =
        timedCapturedCfg M clock (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T)
route: Apply to M.tm at the known halted deadline T. Use canonical equality (in the required orientation) for timedCapturedCfg and prefix exclusion for timedCapture_run; preserve the t+1 bound.

name: universalCapture_start
literal_header:
lemma universalCapture_start {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : FinTM Bool) (D : MultiTapeTM 4 Bool S) (x : List Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (h : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T).state = none) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ T + 1 ∧
      (universalCaptureTM M D).tm.runFrom ((universalCaptureTM M D).tm.initCfg x) t =
        universalCapturedCfg M D (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T)
route: Apply to M.tm at the known halted deadline T. Use canonical equality for universalCapturedCfg and prefix exclusion for universalCapture_run; preserve the t+1 bound.
